==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. My goal was to determine if Latin words worked as magic spells. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (What motivated this dream was the fact that in my last dream, I discovered that the Death Demon's name was an actual Latin word. This made me question whether Latin itself could act as a magical tool in this world.)

Fingo, ligo, porta, and solvo all work as expected. (Fingo allows me to create things. Ligo lets me create magical links between things. Porta lets me create portals. Solvo lets me destroy things. Pronunciation seems to matter less than intent, as I am pretty sure I kept saying lingo instead of ligo (but it still worked as expected).)

Using these spells, I created a door to a golden world of Were-Gators for the Alligator Men and their leader. (With these powers, I think I can give everyone what they want. The leader of the Alligator Men and some of their Alligator Men actually went through the portal to enjoy this new world I conjured for them.) (The leader of the Alligator Men resembles a woman with light brown skin, a curly orange afro, and a long yellow dress.) (The Alligator Men resemble humanoid alligators dressed like barbarians.)
